verdict.rationale: Basecamp's Docs & Files natively holds cloud files from Google Docs (plus Figma and Dropbox), which partly covers the Google Drive part of the story. There is no evidence of native Slack or GitHub integrations; Basecamp instead positions its own chat as a Slack replacement, and the REST API/OAuth are only developer building blocks. Missing for 10: native Slack integration, native GitHub integration, an explicit Google Drive connector beyond embedding Google Docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Docs & Files keeps images, documents, PDFs, even cloud files from Figma, Google Docs, and Dropbox neatly organized inside your projects.
